parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` is expected in a test file: both methods exercise fallback-to-default behaviour of the playlist API version logic, but they cover distinct scenarios (no override/flag present vs. an invalid feature flag value). Merging or extracting them would obscure the intent of each test case and reduce diagnostic clarity when either assertion fails. No production code is involved, so there is no coupling risk to address.
